visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male creator with dark hair, wearing a grey ribbed zip-up knit sweater, stands on a bustling urban sidewalk at dusk. He looks directly into the camera with a cheerful expression, waving his right hand. The background is a street in Omotesando, Tokyo, featuring modern glass buildings, green glowing neon signs, and blurred pedestrians in winter clothing. White text appears at the top center. (2) The scene shifts to the creator standing in front of a brightly lit Onitsuka Tiger store. He points his index finger toward the store's yellow-lit interior through the glass facade. The street background is slightly out of focus, showing more city lights and people. Large white text overlays the top half of the screen. (3) Inside the shoe store, the creator holds up a black distressed-style sneaker with white stripes. He turns the shoe to show its details. The environment is crowded with other shoppers and shelves filled with various footwear. White text appears at the bottom. (4) The camera focuses on the creator's feet as he sits on a wooden bench, trying on the black sneakers. He wears dark blue pinstriped trousers. His hands reach down to adjust the laces. Other shoes and a shopping bag are visible on the floor nearby. (5) In a mirror reflection, the creator stands in a changing room, taking a selfie. He is wearing the same grey sweater and striped pants. The lighting is bright and flat. Text at the bottom indicates a brand name. (6) A young woman with blonde hair, wearing a black coat and a light green knit hood-scarf, talks animatedly inside a white-walled store. She uses expressive hand gestures. Large pink variety-show style text flashes on the screen. The background is a minimalist retail space. (7) Close-up of a black leather loafer decorated with numerous small 3D leather flowers on the toe. The shoe is held against a backdrop of white retail shelves. Pink and black text is overlaid. (8) The creator stands outside the Cocochi flagship store, which has a distinctive grey facade with cross-shaped cutouts. He gestures toward the entrance. A red location pin icon appears on screen. (9) A top-down shot of a wooden table at a cafe reveals three aesthetically arranged drinks: a yellow citrus beverage, a layered red and orange drink with a leaf, and a white creamy drink. A dessert plate with a small cake is also present. (10) The creator is shown eating a Mont Blanc dessert with a silver spoon. He looks pleasantly surprised and nods while chewing. The background is the warm, dimly lit interior of the cafe. Yellow text appears around his face. (11) In a skincare retail section, the creator stands in front of glass shelves displaying gold and silver cosmetic bottles. He speaks to the camera while gesturing toward the products. The lighting is bright and professional. (12) Close-up on a pair of hands. One person is applying a clear lotion from a gold bottle onto the back of another person's hand. They are sitting at a white counter. (13) The creator stands outside at night in front of the 'Pocket' jewelry store. He shows several silver rings on his fingers to the camera. The street is dark with glowing shop signs. (14) Final shot of the creator back on the street, pointing his finger at the camera and nodding. He has a playful smile. Large white subtitles appear at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-arousal male voice speaking excitedly in Mandarin. Concurrently, a vibrant electronic pop BGM kicks in with a clear 120 BPM beat and a female English vocal hook. A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect emphasizes the first visual cut. (2) The BGM continues with synthesized melodies as the male speaker maintains an energetic, friendly tone. A sharp 'pop' SFX accompanies the appearance of variety text. Ambient room tone from a retail environment is barely audible under the music. (3) A quick 'impact' SFX triggers as the scene shifts to showing shoes. The speaker's pitch variability increases as he expresses admiration for the products. There is a faint sound of rustling fabric. (4) A young female voice enters with a high-pitched and animated intonation, expressing delight. The BGM remains steady, providing a consistent energy. A bright 'ding' bell sound effect highlights a specific product reveal. (5) A liquid 'splash' sound effect is heard as a transition to the cafe scene. The male voice continues with a warm, satisfied timbre while describing the food. The BGM provides a rhythmic foundation without overpowering the speech. (6) A 'sparkle' sound effect accompanies the shots of skincare products. The speaker's voice becomes more intimate and narrative. There is a soft sound of a pump being pressed. (7) A percussive 'hit' SFX signals the final shop segment. The male voice concludes with a confident, falling intonation pattern. The BGM builds slightly in volume before a clean hard cut at the very end.
